rules.name: research_before_code
rules.description: No code changes allowed without a completed research file at .memory-bank/research/current-task.md

rules.name: allowed_files_only
rules.description: Code changes must only touch files listed in .memory-bank/research/current-task.md under 'allowed_files'

rules.name: no_push_to_main
rules.description: Direct git push to main branch is forbidden

rules.name: no_windows_paths
rules.description: Windows-style paths (e.g. C:\\Users\\) must not appear in any file

rules.name: project_scoped_memory
rules.description: Memory files must live inside .memory-bank/ and must not reference external paths
